intro: The Expo large display unit helps you create a home that feels curated and organised. Whether it’s books, keepsakes, or cherished décor, every item has a place to shine—without clutter or compromise.

features.title: Ample space for your most treasured displays
features.text: We’ve designed our display unit to give your books, décor, and artefacts the space they deserve—so every shelf feels like a showcase.

features.title: Tempered glass shutters for protection
features.text: Our sleek glass panels keep dust away while letting your collection shine, giving your space an elegant and polished look.

features.title: Clean finish for a warm, stylish touch
features.text: A beautiful cherry finish adds depth and character, making it a perfect fit for modern and classic homes alike.

features.title: Silent-closing doors for everyday ease
features.text: We’ve added Ebco bumpers to ensure smooth, quiet closing—so you can enjoy effortless storage without the noise.

features.title: A mix of open and closed storage
features.text: Showcase what you love on open shelves while keeping clutter neatly tucked away in concealed compartments.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
